CA.rationale: No attention/allocation relation is explicitly tied to the same identified content/time.

COD.rationale: Content (red locations), an explicit presentation pattern, and a separate origin/status field are all present and bound to p1/current/n2.

A.rationale: Process-related origin metadata (e.g. feedback/history/command_estimate) is present but not explicitly framed as an attention/allocation relation to the content's presentation; status remains ambiguous.

C.rationale: The report explicitly identifies contents (red, blue) with exact coordinate sets.

D.rationale: Origin/status metadata is given separately from the red/blue coordinate content, distinguishing content from provenance/status.

O.rationale: The report specifies how contents are presented (coordinate patterns, candidate/full-grid presentations) tied to specific referents and times.
